parameters.name: FromUnitId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source cost center.

*   A value of 0 indicates that the resources to be transferred have not been allocated to a cost center.
*   A value greater than 0 indicates the ID of an existing cost center.

parameters.name: FromUnitUserId
parameters.description: The user ID of the owner of the source cost center.

parameters.name: ResourceInstanceList
parameters.description: The resource instances to be transferred.

sub_parameters.name: ApportionCode
sub_parameters.description:
The split item of the shared instance. This parameter is required only for shared instances.

*   Eight cloud services support bill splitting. The commodity codes of the eight services are oss, dcdn, snapshot, vod, cdn, live, and cbwp.
*   You can obtain the split item of a shared instance by calling QueryCostUnitResource operation to obtain all resource instances within a cost center.

sub_parameters.name: CommodityCode
sub_parameters.description: The commodity code of the resource instance.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the resource instance.

sub_parameters.name: ResourceUserId
sub_parameters.description: The user ID of the resource instance owner.

parameters.name: ToUnitId
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination cost center.

*   A value of -1 indicates that the allocated resources are changed to unallocated.
*   A value greater than 0 indicates the ID of an existing cost center.

parameters.name: ToUnitUserId
parameters.description: The user ID of the owner of the destination cost center.
